assessment.guidance: Judge the final work yourself. Packaging checks are not quality scores.

prompt: make a static webapp showing a 3d interactive snow globe showing a scene with a snow-capped peak

settings.thinkingBudgetBasis: CLI/model default; no explicit token budget

artifact.note: Self-contained single-file 3D snow globe (index.html, ~21.6 KB, no external assets or network). Custom software 3D renderer on 2D canvas: heightfield snow-capped mountain (30x30 grid, altitude/normal-based snow coloring), 14 low-poly conifers, 280 snowflake particles with wind, sphere-boundary bouncing, and terrain landing/accumulation. Painter's-algorithm depth sorting over quads/triangles/sprites using a preallocated pool and Float64Array depth keys; backface culling plus Lambert shading. Perspective orbit camera with drag, wheel/pinch zoom, click-to-shake with impulse and decaying jitter, idle auto-rotate, Space/R/double-click controls, and a Shake button. Packaging check returned valid:true with no errors.
